name: Oriana Power Ltd.
summary: Oriana Power Ltd. operates as a comprehensive renewable energy solutions provider, primarily focusing on solar energy for industrial, commercial, and government clients. The company's core services include Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) of solar power projects, as well as offering solar energy solutions on a Build, Own, Operate, Transfer (BOOT) basis, known as the Renewable Energy Service Company (RESCO) model. These solutions encompass on-site installations like rooftop and ground-mounted systems, off-site solar farms through open access, floating solar panels, solar parks, and carport solar. Additionally, Oriana Power provides operation and maintenance services for these projects. The company is actively diversifying its offerings within the low-carbon energy sector to include Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), Compressed Bio-Gas (CBG), and Green Hydrogen and e-fuels, which involve green ammonia and hydrogen electrolyzers. Oriana Power also undertakes the construction, installation, and maintenance of related power infrastructure such as power stations, cables, and lines. The company serves clients across India, operating in 22 states, and has an international presence in select markets including Africa, the Middle East, Kenya, and South Africa.
